title: Amazingly Aromatic Mediterranean Lamb Kebabs
description: A nutty and gooey Mediterranean dish perfect for a date night, featuring lamb kebabs, fries, and fermented elements, all while being low-glycemic-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, sumac, and salt.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated lamb onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the lamb kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until they reach an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the lamb is cooking, toss the sweet potato fries with a little bit of olive oil and season with salt.
Bake the sweet potato fries in the oven at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 20-25 minutes, or until crispy.
Warm the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for a few minutes.
Assemble the kebabs by slicing the cooked lamb and serving it in the pita bread with feta cheese, dates, and sweet potato fries.
